artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene. In the foreground, there are figures by a body of water. A character is holding a sword near another figure's neck. There are other figures in robes or gowns around them. The background shows a hilly landscape with a castle and horsemen. Above are angels or mythical creatures among the clouds, with rays of light streaming down.

artworks.title: Paris: Vue prise du pont d'Austerlitz (Paris: View Taken from the Pont d'Austerlitz)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a cityscape in the distance. The horizon aligns with trees and city architecture. A cathedral or church with spires is prominent. The style is detailed etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and sepia. Large boats are moored by the riverbank, with figures nearby suggesting activity. In the distance, there are more structures and a bridge. The sky has soft clouds.

artworks.title: The Water Mill
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques de Boissieu, after Jacob van Ruisdael

artworks.title: A Market Square before a Cathedral
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over charcoal on dark blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street market with people around stalls. In the distance, there is a grand architectural structure with tall spires, likely a cathedral. The horizon is raised, and the gothic spires stand out against the sky. The brushwork is loose and impressionistic, capturing the essence of the scene. The color palette is predominantly muted and cool, with blues and grays dominating. Light hints at a soft glow, adding accents to the scene.

artworks.title: A Scene in York: York Minster from Lop Lane
artworks.creditLine: Edward J. Lenkin Fund, Melvin and Thelma Lenkin Fund and Stephen G. Stein Fund
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a street lined with buildings leading towards a distant cathedral.  The buildings closest to us appear to be made of brick and have white windows. The street leads off to the left, towards the grand cathedral in the background. The view is from street level, and the photograph has a grainy texture.

artworks.title: East Rock, New Haven
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky ridge extending horizontally across the scene. The viewpoint is at eye level, capturing the full extent of the ridge. The horizon is visible near the top of the ridge, which sits above a blurry wooded area. The ridge gently slopes down on both sides. The foreground features marshy terrain with water channels and tall grass. Haystacks are scattered throughout, leading the eye towards the ridge. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating a vintage look with depth and contrast in the image.

artworks.title: F.W. 4 (Old Chain Battery Walk), West Point, New York
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. On the left, a rocky slope with sparse vegetation runs diagonally upwards. A dirt path meanders along this slope, leading towards trees on the right with branches hanging over it. Beyond the trees is a calm body of water, followed by a forested area. In the distance, rolling hills rise against the horizon, placed high in the frame. The scene has a monochromatic color scheme with sepia tones enhancing natural details and contours of the landscape.

artworks.title: From Trophy Point, West Point, Hudson River
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a waterway with sailboats, trees, and mountains in the distance. The scene has a muted color palette with sepia tones. The water reflects the sailboats.

artworks.title: Ferdinand Hodler
artworks.medium: woodcut [artist's proof before removal of outer border, printed on blue japan paper]
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic portrait showing the upper body and head of a man in profile. The person faces the left side of the image. He has defined facial features with pronounced cheekbones and a prominent nose. His hair is styled high and swept back, and he has a full, curly beard extending from his chin. The man wears a high-collared shirt under a darker garment, though details on the clothing are minimal. The background is plain with a textured effect, and there are no distinct objects in the scene. In the top right corner, there is a square block with the numbers "1904." The bottom left corner contains a signature and date reading "S.F. Pondelik, 6/XII 1904."

artworks.title: Waterfall
artworks.artist: Kaspar Auer, after Johann Jakob Dorner II
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from a higher perspective. The horizon features distant mountains. Near a stream, a figure stands while a log cabin sits on a hillside among trees. The scene is depicted with detailed brushwork imitating natural textures. The color scheme is primarily sepia tones. Hills lead to the mountains in the distance under a sky painted with delicate brushstrokes.

artworks.title: The Hierarchy of the Heavens
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple tiers of figures within an ornately bordered ellipse. The linework shows groups of figures on clouds engaged in activities or posed in various formations. Swirling clouds separate each tier, leading to a celestial realm where a central figure is surrounded by angelic beings. The artwork includes ornamental borders with floral and vine motifs.

artworks.title: Wandering Death
artworks.description: The image shows a skeletal figure in full-body profile, walking to the right with an arched back while holding a long stick. The figure has a head turned slightly towards the viewer, featuring pronounced eye sockets and a toothy grin. It is wearing a large, flowing draped garment that appears tattered, exposing its ribcage and bony limbs. The feet are skeletal, and the legs are bent as if stepping over an uneven surface. The background is indicated by flowing lines suggestive of wind or movement.

artworks.title: Ziegenbock
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid Japanese tissue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a goat standing in a stylized landscape. The drawing features a prominently detailed goat in the foreground, drawn with thick, contrasting lines. The goat's fur is emphasized with intricate line work. In the background, swirling lines suggest rolling hills or mountains, with a sun or moon partially obscured by stylized clouds. There is another smaller animal depicted in the scene. The overall composition has a vivid contrast between the dark lines and light paper.

artworks.title: Man Leading a Little Girl
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two figures: one larger and one smaller. The larger figure is turned away, wearing a hat and a long coat. The smaller figure stands to the right, facing away but slightly turned toward the adult, holding their hand. The child has short hair and wears a dress or coat. The figures are against a plain, textured background, implying a natural setting.

artworks.title: Six Diners at Table
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal drawing depicting the upper bodies of five individuals closely gathered together. They are positioned to form a compact group, possibly interacting. Each person has distinct facial features portrayed with expressive, bold strokes. The individuals have diverse hair and facial structures in an intense, somewhat abstract style. Their clothing details are difficult to discern, but they seem to be wearing long-sleeved garments. Some individuals are holding bowls and utensils, suggesting a possible food or dining scenario. No discernible jewelry is present, as the focus is on their interactions with the objects. The background is plain, highlighting the figures and their central activity.

artworks.title: Street Scene with a Cripple and a Praying Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract figures in a confined space. The composition includes bold lines and expressive forms suggesting movement and emotion. Architectural elements like railings and a lamp post-like structure hint at an outdoor environment. The artwork uses a rough, sketch-like technique to highlight the contours and expressions of the figures, creating a dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Monastery in the Forest
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone castle surrounded by trees. A tall spire and turret rise above the castle. The horizon is low in the composition, mostly hidden by tree foliage. The drawing is detailed with intricate lines and cross-hatching, creating textures and shadows on the stone and vegetation. The color palette is monochrome sepia. A small river flows near the castle with shrubs on its banks. A small figure sits near the stream. Trees continue into the background.

artworks.title: Veduta di Albe e Monte Velino negli Abruzzi
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a mountain range in the distance, hills in the foreground, and a village nestled against the hills. Trees and ancient ruins are present in the foreground, and the etching-style drawing uses fine lines and shading in a monochromatic palette to depict the scene.

artworks.title: Badeanstalt (The Bath House)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and dark smudges forming an abstract scene. The central figure appears to be bending forward, with surrounding rounded forms and squiggly lines. The background features broad strokes and layers, creating a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch showing the upper part of the body. The person is facing slightly to the side with their head turned slightly towards the viewer. The facial features are depicted with rough lines, including an eye, a forehead, and a nose and cheek. The hair is short and unkempt. The clothing is suggested with faint lines. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and lightly textured, with the sketch signed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Bank im Walde II (Bench in the Woods II)
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective view of a wooded path. Visibility of the horizon is hindered by dense trees. The brushstrokes are sketch-like with expressive lines creating movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and grey on light-colored paper. The ground has hatchings indicating light patches. A wooden bench is slightly off-center to the right. In the background, trees densely populate the landscape.

artworks.title: The Muleteers' Inn
artworks.artist: Christian Wilhelm Ernst Dietrich, after Pieter van Laer
artworks.description: The scene depicts a rustic structure surrounded by ruins and foliage. Tall rocky formations and an arched ruin are prominent in the background. The artwork showcases detailed etching techniques with fine lines creating textures in the stonework, foliage, and sky. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white, emphasizing depth and detail. A small dwelling with a tiled roof and a chimney is surrounded by overgrown vegetation and wooden fencing. Near the structure, there are chickens, a dog, and a person engaging in activities. In the distance, dramatic ruins suggest a historical setting embraced by nature.

artworks.title: Birkenstämme im Tiergarten (Birch Trees in the Tiergarten)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of trees with detailed bark and branches seen from a low angle. The brushstrokes create texture and tonal variations resembling cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic, with a stark contrast between black and white. The trees converge upwards, with the horizon not distinctly visible. The foreground shows intricate details of the tree trunks and foliage while the background fades into lighter, less defined forms.

artworks.title: Kreuzigung, nach dem Altarbild in Tölz (Crucifixion, after the Altarpiece at Tölz)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a central figure with arms extended above the head. The figure has long hair, a thin and muscular build, and is unclothed. Surrounding the central figure are other figures in dark, flowing clothes. Above the central figure's head is a sign with the inscription "INRI." In the background, there are cross beams and a skull at the base of the cross. The overall composition is intricate and detailed.
